categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, production, and sales of internal combustion engine (ICE) and hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) intake systems, fuel evaporation systems, new energy vehicle thermal management systems, and hydrogen fuel cell cathode filtration systems. Main products include automotive intake systems and components, motorcycle intake systems and components, and general machinery intake systems and components. The company also develops vehicle-mounted smart electronic products such as intelligent instrument clusters.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including CAE simulation technology, low-noise intake system technology, fuel evaporation pollution control technology, and infrared welding. Manufacturing methods include plastic blow molding (HDPE, TEEE, PP), injection molding, high-frequency vibration friction welding, infrared welding, and hot air welding. The company has CNAS-certified testing laboratories and employs advanced molding and welding techniques for plastic component manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major domestic and international automotive, motorcycle, and general machinery manufacturers such as GAC Group, Geely Group, Chery Group, BYD, Great Wall Motors, Honda, Yamaha, Suzuki, BMW, KTM, and various Chinese motorcycle brands. The company serves both original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and supplies components for passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and garden machinery applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with four major production bases located in Taizhou (Zhejiang), Jiangmen (Guangdong), Tongliang (Chongqing), and Changzhou (Jiangsu). The company established a subsidiary in Japan (Hengbo Co., Ltd.) in November 2024 and is actively planning overseas market expansion. Domestic sales account for 99.05% of revenue, with limited international sales at 0.95%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the automotive supply chain as a Tier-1 supplier of components to original equipment manufacturers. The company provides integrated intake system solutions and related components directly to vehicle manufacturers, positioning itself as a key component supplier rather than an end-product manufacturer or raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening main business operations, expanding market share in intake systems, accelerating new energy vehicle product development, and pursuing overseas market expansion. R&D focuses on lightweight technology, intelligent electronic applications, thermal management systems for new energy vehicles, hydrogen fuel cell systems, and smart instrument clusters. The company invested 52.59 million yuan in R&D in 2024, representing 6.08% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products to original equipment manufacturers. Revenue comes from three main product categories: motorcycle intake systems (32.47% of 2024 revenue), automotive intake systems (61.26%), and general machinery intake systems (3.12%). The company operates on a make-to-order basis with direct sales to major automotive and motorcycle manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the intake systems segment, competing against international suppliers such as German MAHLE and other foreign manufacturers. The company holds a prominent industry position as a national specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise and is recognized as a leading enterprise in China's internal combustion engine parts industry. The company is gradually replacing foreign suppliers in the domestic market through superior cost-effectiveness and responsiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 865.11 million yuan, representing 10.15% growth from 2023 (785.43 million yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 131.05 million yuan in 2024, up 14.23% year-over-year. Total assets reached 1.87 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company demonstrates steady growth with improving profitability and strong cash generation capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced R&D capabilities, rapid market response, comprehensive testing facilities (CNAS-certified), and integrated product solutions. Key competitive advantages include mastery of multiple manufacturing technologies, lightweight product design, noise reduction capabilities, and ability to provide synchronized development services with OEMs. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer service, offering modular intake system solutions that meet evolving automotive industry requirements for electrification and intelligence.
